svg.title: Built for the agent loop.
svg.desc: CLICKS + DOM UPDATE: Umbra 1.52 ms; Playwright Chromium 16.02 ms (10.5×); Playwright WebKit 65.85 ms (43.3×); ACCESSIBILITY SNAPSHOTS: Umbra 0.94 ms; Playwright Chromium 3.57 ms (3.8×); Playwright WebKit 4.41 ms (4.7×); CONTROLLED FORM FILLING: Umbra 1.27 ms; Playwright Chromium 2.13 ms (1.7×); Playwright WebKit 2.96 ms (2.3×); PNG SCREENSHOTS: Umbra 50.16 ms; Playwright Chromium 84.86 ms (1.7×); Playwright WebKit 57.12 ms (1.1×). Same local fixtures · 20-run medians · Apple M1 Pro · recorded 2026-10-13. Umbra daemon socket vs Playwright 1.62.1 drivers. Excludes fresh CLI/MCP overhead. Clicks include each tool’s actionability policy. STATEFUL MCP OBSERVATIONS: 50% fewer canonical result tokens vs Playwright MCP Chromium and WebKit; Umbra 12,491, Chromium 25,434, WebKit 25,211. Complete task prose, form state and actionable controls retained. 27 local states × 3 repeats per browser · median totals · o200k_base · 2026-10-23 UTC. Umbra opt-in observe deltas + full text on every state vs Playwright MCP 0.0.83 full snapshots. Initial/reset snapshots included. Canonical result JSON only; setup/actions excluded. Not total agent or billed tokens.
